title: Broadcom Redefines AI Infrastructure with Industry-Leading Networking Innovations at 2026 OCP Global Summit
key_facts: Broadcom announced on 8 Oct 2026 it will present AI networking innovations at the OCP Global Summit, 12-15 October in San Jose.
Featured: Tomahawk 6, Tomahawk Ultra and Jericho 4 Ethernet switches; Thor Ultra 800G and Thor 2 400G AI Ethernet NICs; third-generation TH6-Davisson co-packaged optics.
The products are for Open Rack Version 3 solutions to scale AI infrastructure.
Asad Khamisy will give a keynote on 12 Oct on scaling AI infrastructure for clusters of over 100,000 accelerators.
Broadcom speakers will present sessions with partners including Celestica, Molex, OpenAI, Arista and Microsoft.
quote_evidence: Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ: AVGO) ... today announced it is set to present its latest innovations in scale-up, scale-out, and scale-across AI networking at the 2026 Open Compute Project (OCP) Global Summit.

Running from October 12-15 in San Jose, Broadcom will feature Ethernet switches, NICs, PCIe components and integrated optics to power Open Rack Version 3 (ORV3) solutions for scaling AI infrastructure.
why_it_matters_hint: Preview of Broadcom's AI networking line-up for a coming industry show.
